speaker: en_a
text: Hello, I want to plan a meeting. What day is good for you?

speaker: es_a
text: Hola, quiero planear una reunión. ¿Qué día te queda bien?

speaker: en_b
text: Let me see. Today is Monday, July 28. I am free this Friday.

speaker: es_b
text: Déjame ver. Hoy es lunes, 28 de julio. Estoy libre este viernes.

speaker: en_a
text: Friday is August 1, right?

speaker: es_a
text: El viernes es 1 de agosto, ¿verdad?

speaker: en_b
text: Yes, that is correct.

speaker: es_b
text: Sí, correcto.

speaker: en_a
text: I cannot do Friday. How about Saturday, August 2?

speaker: es_a
text: No puedo el viernes. ¿Qué tal el sábado, 2 de agosto?

speaker: en_b
text: I will be busy on Saturday. What about Sunday, August 3?

speaker: es_b
text: Estaré ocupado el sábado. ¿Y el domingo, 3 de agosto?

speaker: en_a
text: That works. At what time?

speaker: es_a
text: Eso sí me funciona. ¿A qué hora?

speaker: en_b
text: In the afternoon. Maybe at 3:00 p.m.

speaker: es_b
text: En la tarde. Tal vez a las 3:00 p.m.

speaker: en_a
text: Perfect. So, Sunday, August 3 at 3:00 p.m.

speaker: es_a
text: Perfecto. Entonces, domingo 3 de agosto a las 3:00 p.m.

speaker: en_b
text: Where do you want to meet?

speaker: es_b
text: ¿Dónde nos vemos?

speaker: en_a
text: At the library.

speaker: es_a
text: En la biblioteca.

speaker: en_b
text: Great, see you then.

speaker: es_b
text: Excelente, nos vemos entonces.

speaker: en_a
text: Thank you.

speaker: es_a
text: Gracias.
